levels.surface: حبيب بن محمد بن يونس بن شاذان الصنعاني

notes: «أخبرنا جماعة» is an unnamed group of transmitters
«عن رجل» is unnamed; the dashed gloss «ذكر أنه من أهل قزوين لم يذكر اسمه» is an editor gloss and is left out
Habib narrates his own visit; Ali ibn Ibrahim is the one who speaks in the account, so he is the last link (rule 6, owner ruling 5)
The Imam's words inside Ali's account are scene, not links; the reading of the account's last link is a doubt
